description.value: Nobi Nobi Obanzai is a Japanese comfort food restaurant in Richmond inspired by the Obanzai cooking tradition of Kyoto, which centres on small seasonal dishes. The kitchen adapts this tradition using locally sourced ingredients, bridging authentic Japanese culinary roots with a contemporary Vancouver-area setting. Online ordering is available, making it a practical stop for a quick meal.
